grammar.summary: 本课学习 not only...but...as well 并列递进结构。

points.title: not only...but...as well
points.explanation: 递进并列：He not only speaks English but French as well. 连接两个对等成分；as well 放句尾表"也"，同 not only...but also。

examples.en: I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
examples.cn: 我英语不仅说得非常认真，而且非常清楚。

points.title: each time 表"每次"
points.explanation: each time = whenever 引导时间从句：Each time I speak to him...

examples.en: The English understand each other, but I don't understand them.
examples.cn: 英国人之间能互相听懂，可我听不懂他们。

exercises.q: She locked the door, ___ she was afraid of thieves.
I did not know the way to my hotel, ___ I asked a porter.
My brother bought her a gift ___ she accepted it.
Then he spoke slowly, ___ I could not understand him.
Either you hurry up, ___ you will be late.
